snippet.title: Under His Eyes - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Under His Eyes is a gritty, story-driven strategy game where you play a crime boss. Make game-changing decisions, manage your crew and income, send operatives on missions, seize districts, and eliminate rivals. Will you rise through subtlety, rule with fear, or fall to a small-time gang?

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938380/Under_His_Eyes/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
